hero.paragraph: The innovation and incubation center of Data Afrique Hub. We support entrepreneurs, startups and builders in creating high-impact technology solutions for tomorrow's Africa — from the first idea to deployment.

about.title: Turning data into a lever for Africa's development
about.paragraph: We turn the community's energy into concrete, documented, reproducible projects built to meet real needs — health, agriculture, education, finance.
about.p1d: We guide data & AI projects from idea to working prototype, with method and rigor.
about.p2d: Mentoring, method and technical support at every stage, from prototype to launch.
about.p3d: A pan-African network of practitioners, institutions and technical partners who help each other.

hero.title1: We help turn bold ideas into
hero.lead: DAH Labs is the innovation and incubation center of Data Afrique Hub. We support entrepreneurs and startups building technology solutions with real impact for tomorrow's Africa.
hero.cardText: Innovation and incubation center — part of the Data Afrique Hub ecosystem.

mv.mission: Support entrepreneurs and startups in creating technology solutions with a strong impact for tomorrow's Africa.
mv.vision: A continent where local data and local talent power the solutions to local challenges.

what.title: Three ways we move projects forward
what.paragraph: From the first idea to a deployed tool, the lab supports every stage.
what.p1d: We guide data & AI projects from idea to working prototype, with method and rigor.
what.p2d: Mentoring, method and technical support at every stage, from prototype to launch.
what.p3d: A pan-African network of practitioners, institutions and technical partners who help each other.

process.title: From idea to deployed project
process.paragraph: A simple path that any member can follow.
process.s1d: A member submits an idea with a clear problem and the impact expected.
process.s2d: The lab reviews ideas for impact, feasibility and the skills available.
process.s3d: A small team forms around the project, with mentoring and regular milestones.
process.s4d: The project is documented, published on GitHub and put in users' hands.

values.title: What guides the way we work
values.v1d: Code, data and lessons learned are shared so others can build on them.
values.v2d: Sound methods, documented choices and results we can explain.
values.v3d: We pick problems that matter to people, not just interesting ones.
values.v4d: Beginners and experts learn from each other on every project.

eco.title: One of the four entities of Data Afrique Hub
eco.paragraph: Data Afrique Hub connects talent, knowledge and opportunities around data and technology. DAH Labs works alongside three sister entities.
eco.tourText: An annual challenge that brings together the best tech talent to design concrete, innovative solutions to Africa's major challenges.
eco.academyText: The academic arm training tomorrow's African experts through degree and certificate programs and strategic international partnerships.
eco.mediaText: The first African media outlet dedicated to AI, Data Science and Cybersecurity, giving visibility to the talent and initiatives shaping the continent's digital future.
eco.labsText: The innovation and incubation center supporting entrepreneurs and startups in creating high-impact technology solutions for tomorrow's Africa.

hero.lead: Every project is open source and built by the community. Open one to read its code on GitHub or try the live version.

propose.title: Have an idea? Let's build it together.
propose.paragraph: Tell us about the problem you want to solve. Beginners are welcome: the lab helps shape the idea and find the right team.
propose.s1d: Who is affected, what data exists, and what a good result would look like.
propose.s2d: The lab looks at impact, feasibility and the skills available in the community.
propose.s3d: Contributors join, a GitHub repository is opened and the first milestones are set.
propose.fDescPh: The problem, the people it helps, the data you have in mind…
